articles.summary: Expro Group Holdings N.V. (NYSE: XPRO) (the “Company” or “Expro”) today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement under which Expro will acquire Enhanced Well Technologies Group AS (“Enhanced Drilling”) for approximately 2 billion Norwegian kroner (“NOK”) in cash plus customary closing and working capital adjustments. The Company also announced its financial and operational results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. Acquisition Highlights Expro expands its high technology-base
articles.title: Expro Announces Agreement to Acquire Enhanced Drilling and First Quarter 2026 Results
